tables.name: Root of Relationship with the People
tables.description: Where the relationship between the classes comes from; its positive or negative reading follows the Relationship with the People. Resources modifies Population Wealth (+2 positive, -2 negative).

results.name: Hardship
results.description: A difficult and trying hardship has happened or is currently happening. The nobility... Positive: ...are sharing in the hardship, or are actively working to ease the burden on the common folk. Negative: ...are not enduring the same hardship as the common folk, and/or are looking after their own interests ahead of supporting others in need.

results.name: Resources
results.description: The common folk feel the nobles... Positive: ...take an appropriate share of resources, and give charitably when able. (+2 to population wealth roll) Negative: ...do not distribute resources fairly, prioritizing plenty for themselves over making sure there is enough for all. (-2 to population wealth roll)

results.name: Manipulation
results.description: An individual or group has orchestrated the sentiment between the two classes. The manipulator is looking out for... Positive: ...the capital’s interests. Negative: ...their own interests.

results.name: Opinion of Leadership
results.description: When it comes to their opinion of the leadership, both sides... Positive: ...agree. Negative: ...disagree.

results.name: Leadership Treatment
results.description: The leadership treats the people and the nobility... Positive: ...equally. Negative: ...differently.
